subject: english
stem: The conversation takes place before everyone goes home. What action or decision is reached by the end?
options: Hugo should wait until tomorrow to check for a fever
Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever
Hugo should call the health center for a sore throat alone
Hugo should call the school office if there is a fever

optionRationales.reason: Hugo should wait until tomorrow to check for a fever：此項把「call the health center if there is」改成「wait until tomorrow to check for」。對話結尾確認「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」。因此，鎖定證據支持「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」。
Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。對話結尾確認「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」。

Hugo should call the health center for a sore throat alone：此項把「if there is a fever」改成「for a sore throat alone」。對話結尾確認「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」。因此，鎖定證據支持「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」。

Hugo should call the school office if there is a fever：此項把「health center」改成「school office」。對話結尾確認「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」。因此，鎖定證據支持「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：逐句比對鎖定逐字稿，答案為「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」。
獨立覆核 B：重新依時間順序核對說話者、細節與行動，只有「Hugo should call the health center if there is a fever」成立。
